title: The Alignment Tax Is Graded: Task-Selective Capability Loss Under Length-Normalized DPO with SFT Retention
abstract: arXiv:2611.06476v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Setting. This is an empirical characterization study; we propose no new method and run no comparisons against alternative objectives. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-4B with sparse LoRA and length-normalized DPO plus an SFT retention term (the RPO objective) on structured financial-filing tasks, and track downstream capability as the implicit reward margin grows to $\sim 7$ $\beta$-scaled units (nf4 training; $\sim 3$ under fp16 measurement on the unquantized base). Question. Does margin growth degrade capability uniformly across tasks, or selectively? Findings. In a pre-registered study (8 seeds, 6 unseen at freeze) with artifact-aware scoring and TOST equivalence testing, the alignment tax is graded and task-selective: extraction is preserved ($\Delta = -0.55$ pts, equivalent at $\pm5$ pts), json loses little ($\Delta = -3.52$ pts, equivalence fails on a clustered item-level interval), and router degrades severely ($\Delta = -30$ pts). translated_title: 对齐代价是分级的：SFT保留下长度归一化DPO的任务选择性能力损失
translated_abstract: 设定。这是一项实证特征描述研究；我们未提出新方法，也未与其他目标函数进行对比。我们在结构化财务报告任务上，使用稀疏LoRA和长度归一化DPO加上SFT保留项（即RPO目标）对Qwen3.5-4B进行微调，并跟踪下游能力随隐式奖励边际增长至约7个β缩放单位（nf4量化训练；在未量化的基础模型上以fp16测量时约为3）时的变化。问题。边际增长是否会在所有任务上均匀地降低能力，还是具有选择性？发现。在一项预注册的研究（8个随机种子，其中6个在冻结前未使用）中，通过伪影感知评分和TOST等效性检验，对齐代价是分级的且具有任务选择性：信息抽取能力得以保留（Δ = -0.55分，在±5分范围内等效），json能力损失很小（Δ = -3.52分，在聚类后的项目级区间上等效性检验未通过），而路由能力严重退化（Δ = -30分）。
tldr: 对齐微调带来的能力损失并非均匀发生，而是分级且任务选择性的——抽取类任务几乎不受影响，JSON生成轻微下降，而路由任务出现约30分的严重退化。
en_tdlr: Alignment-induced capability loss is graded and task-selective rather than uniform: extraction is preserved, JSON degrades slightly, and router performance drops severely by ~30 points under length-normalized DPO with SFT retention.
